messages.content: 甲列火车以 60 公里/小时的速度从 X 城向东出发。30 分钟后,乙列火车从 Y 城(在 X 城以东 300 公里处)以 80 公里/小时的速度向西出发。他们何时何地相遇?

message.content:
<think>The user asks a problem in Chinese: "甲列火车以 60 公里/小时的速度从 X 城向东出发。30 分钟后,乙列火车从 Y 城(在 X 城以东 300 公里处)以 80 公里/小时的速度向西出发。他们何时何地相遇?" The problem: Two trains start from X and Y, respectively, moving towards each other (east-west). Train A (甲) starts from X heading east at 60 km/h. Train B (乙) starts from Y heading west at 80 km/h. Y is 300 km east of X. After 30 minutes (0.5 hour) after Train A leaves, Train B leaves. We need to find when and where they meet.

We need to set up a coordinate system. Let X be at position x=0, Y at x=300 km (east). Train A moves east (+ direction) at speed v_A = 60 km/h. Train B moves west (- direction) at speed v_B = 80 km/h. Train A starts at t=0. Train B starts at t=0.5 h (30 min). At t < 0.5 h, Train B hasn't started yet. After t >= 0.5 h, both moving.

We need to find t_meet such that positions are equal. Let t be absolute time from Train A departure. For t <= 0.5, Train A position: x_A(t) = v_A * t = 60 t. Train B hasn't moved, so x_B(t) = 300. For t >= 0.5, Train A position: x_A(t) = 60 t (since constant speed). Train B position: x_B(t) = 300 - v_B * (t - 0.5) = 300 - 80 (t - 0.5). They meet when x_A(t) = x_B(t). Solve for t >= 0.5.

Set 60 t = 300 - 80 (t - 0.5) => 60 t = 300 - 80 t + 40 => 60 t + 80 t = 300 + 40 => 140 t = 340 => t = 340/140 = 34/14 = 17/7 ≈ 2.428571... hours. That's > 0.5, so valid.

Thus meeting time after Train A departure: t
